name: NGINX + PHP
description: NGINX web server with PHP-FPM for modern PHP applications. Ships gd, imagick, imap, intl, soap, ldap, bcmath, gmp, exif, xsl, mysqli, pgsql, memcached, apcu and redis.

parameters.label: Document Root
parameters.description: Web server document root path. Use /var/www/html/public for Laravel/Symfony.

parameters.label: Timezone
parameters.description: PHP default timezone (e.g. UTC, Europe/Berlin, America/New_York).

parameters.label: Display Errors
parameters.description: Send PHP errors to the browser. Keep Off in production — On leaks file paths and query fragments to visitors.

parameters.label: Display Startup Errors
parameters.description: Show errors raised during PHP's own startup. Keep Off in production.

parameters.label: Error Log Destination
parameters.description: Where PHP writes its error log. /dev/stderr surfaces errors in the deployment's Logs tab.

parameters.label: Error Reporting Bitmask
parameters.description: Which errors PHP reports. 22527 = E_ALL & ~E_DEPRECATED & ~E_STRICT (default), 32767 = E_ALL.

parameters.label: FPM Process Manager
parameters.description: ondemand starts workers only when needed (lowest idle memory), dynamic keeps spares warm, static pins a fixed count.

parameters.label: FPM Max Workers
parameters.description: Maximum concurrent PHP workers, and the biggest memory lever here: each worker may grow to PHP Memory Limit. Raise it together with the deployment's memory.

parameters.label: FPM Requests Per Worker
parameters.description: Recycle a worker after this many requests, which bounds memory leaks in long-lived PHP processes. 0 never recycles.

parameters.label: FPM Max Spare Workers
parameters.description: Only used when FPM Process Manager is dynamic.

parameters.label: FPM Min Spare Workers
parameters.description: Only used when FPM Process Manager is dynamic.

parameters.label: FPM Start Workers
parameters.description: Only used when FPM Process Manager is dynamic.

parameters.label: Max Execution Time
parameters.description: Maximum script execution time in seconds.

parameters.label: Max Input Parse Time
parameters.description: Seconds allowed for parsing request data. -1 means use Max Execution Time.

parameters.label: Max Input Variables
parameters.description: Maximum GET/POST variables per request. Large forms, bulk edits and product imports silently truncate at this limit — raise it if data goes missing on submit.

parameters.label: PHP Memory Limit
parameters.description: Maximum memory per PHP script (e.g. 128M, 256M, 512M).

parameters.label: OPcache
parameters.description: Enable PHP OPcache for better performance (1 = on, 0 = off).

parameters.label: OPcache File Override
parameters.description: Let OPcache answer file_exists()/is_file() from its cache. Faster, but stale for files written at runtime.

parameters.label: OPcache Interned Strings (MB)
parameters.description: Memory for OPcache's shared string table.

parameters.label: OPcache JIT Mode
parameters.description: JIT costs memory and rarely helps typical request/response web workloads. Leave off unless you have measured a gain.

parameters.label: OPcache JIT Buffer (bytes)
parameters.description: Only meaningful when OPcache JIT Mode is not off.

parameters.label: OPcache Max Files
parameters.description: Upper bound on cached PHP files. Large frameworks can exceed 10000.

parameters.label: OPcache Memory (MB)
parameters.description: Shared memory claimed at startup for compiled PHP. 64 suits a typical site; large frameworks may want 128 — raise the deployment's memory alongside it.

parameters.label: OPcache Revalidate (seconds)
parameters.description: How often OPcache re-checks a file's timestamp. Only used when OPcache Validate Timestamps is 1.

parameters.label: OPcache Keep Docblocks
parameters.description: Doctrine and other annotation-driven frameworks break without docblocks. 0 saves a little memory.

parameters.label: OPcache Validate Timestamps
parameters.description: 1 picks up edited files automatically. 0 is faster but every code change then needs a deployment restart.

parameters.label: Open Basedir
parameters.description: Restrict PHP's filesystem access to these paths (colon-separated). Empty means unrestricted. Setting it breaks apps that use /tmp unless /tmp is included.

parameters.label: Disabled PHP Functions
parameters.description: Comma-separated PHP functions to disable for WEB requests only (FPM pool scope; CLI and cron keep them, so composer/wp-cli/occ still work). The platform sets this automatically on multi-host deployments, because open_basedir does not restrain a child process — shell_exec walks straight past it into a neighbouring site. Recommended: exec,shell_exec,system,passthru,popen,proc_open,pcntl_exec

parameters.label: POST Max Size
parameters.description: Maximum size for POST request body (should be >= upload max).

parameters.label: Realpath Cache TTL (seconds)
parameters.description: How long PHP caches resolved paths. Higher is faster but slower to notice moved files.

parameters.label: Secure Session Cookie
parameters.description: Send the session cookie only over HTTPS. Safe to enable — the platform terminates TLS at the edge and redirects HTTP.

parameters.label: Upload Max File Size
parameters.description: Maximum size for a single uploaded file.

parameters.label: Zend Detect Unicode
parameters.description: Legacy Zend Multibyte setting. Leave empty unless you know you need it.

parameters.label: Zend Multibyte
parameters.description: Legacy support for multibyte-encoded PHP source files. Leave Off unless you know you need it.
